sentences.text:
Aman Dhurvey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 March,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:12572
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Devnarayan Mishra

On The 12th Of March, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 6180 of 2025
 Aman Dhurvey
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Mr. Devesh Bhojne - Advocate for applicant.
 Mr. Sunil Gupta - Panel Lawyer for State.
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.245 of 2024 registered at Police Station-Ravanwara, District-Chhindwara (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the victim herself has filed an affidavit before the trial Court and admitted the fact that there was a love affair between the parties and family members of the victim were not ready to marry her with the applicant and on their pressure,
she lodged the F.I.R. Victim has no objection if the benefit of bail is granted to the applicant.
From the F.I.R itself, it is clear that the victim was a consenting party and she was a major at the time of incident.
F.I.R. was lodged after an inordinate delay of six months from the first incident, hence, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and has submitted that no indulgence is required and prayed that the bail application be dismissed.

4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Looking to the age, gap of time between the incident and the F.I.R, this Court deems it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case,
the bail application is allowed.
